programme.desc: 由外交部駐澳門特派員公署和澳門特區政府聯合舉辦澳廣視承辦的奏響新時代絲路樂章 共創人類命運共同體 向葡語國家電視台贈送大國建造第三季共同的建造紀錄片儀式順利舉行ampampampampampampltbrampampampampampampgt外交部駐澳門特派員公署連續五年向葡語國家贈送中國優秀葡語譯製紀錄片今年贈送的共同的建造是大國建造的續篇，透過50個充滿煙火氣息的故事，展現中國建造者與一帶一路共建國家人民攜手將藍圖變為實景的歷程，讓葡語國家觀眾更真切理解共建一帶一路的精神內涵ampampampampampampltbrampampampampampampgt出席儀式包括外交部駐澳門公署特派員卞立新，特區政府社會文化司司長代表教育及青年發展局局長龔志明，澳廣視董事會主席高開賢，旅遊局局長文綺華，新聞局局長黃樂宜，安哥拉莫桑比克駐澳門總領事，葡萄牙駐澳門總領事館參贊，以及佛得角幾內亞比紹聖多美等葡語國家電視台代表儀式並設表演環節，由國家級非物質文化遺產代表性項目川劇變臉，配合現代街舞的動感演繹，向葡語國家媒體展示中華優秀傳統文化的創新生命力

乘風踏浪
programme.desc: 乘風踏浪由喬杉楊子姍領銜主演的時代創業喜劇該劇講述了以彭錦西和羅虹夫婦為代表的興城泳裝人乘著改革東風成功創業的故事，通過兩個小人物從解決溫飽到成為萬元戶，再到成為當地企業家代表的歷程，將時代發展浪潮的關鍵節點一一還原，以小見大地展現出改革開放的變遷史ampampampampampltbrampampampampampgt1978年，20歲的遼寧興城人彭錦西（喬杉飾）被情敵秦升舉報投機倒把入獄，失去了上大學的資格彭錦西出獄後自產自銷做起泳褲生意，女友羅虹（楊子姍飾）不離不棄，他們克服重重困難喜結連理，彭錦西成為當地第一個萬元戶1980年代初，政策放開，遠親賈為民等人效仿彭錦西建作坊做泳裝，開始與他展開價格戰，彭錦西夫婦見招拆招，既鞏固了本地市場，又團結了同行，讓興城泳裝走向全國1990年代，彭錦西遭遇秦升復仇和市場整改的雙面夾擊，跌入低谷，他依舊樂觀，憑藉過人的智慧，幾經沉浮找到突破口，建立正規工廠和自主品牌，成功突圍之後，夫婦二帶領興城泳裝乘風踏浪，成為全球最大的泳裝生產基地

programme.desc: 뉴스 채널 YTN의 기본축을 이루는 뉴스 프로그램. 정확성과 속보성을 최대한 살려 최신 정보를 필요로하는 시청자들의 욕구를 만족시켜 준다. 특히 뉴스 휠 방식을 도입함으로써 그 날의 주요 뉴스와 함께 방송시간 직전까지 기자들이 송고한 최신 소식을 매시간 뉴스 편집에 반영함으로써 가장 생생한 소식을 시청자들에게 전달한다. 또 진행 중인 사건, 사고의 변화되는 상황을 그때 그때 전달해 뉴스에 대한 시청자들의 궁금증을 해소하고 전반적인 변화에 대한 시청자들의 이해를 돕는다.

광복80주년 특집기획 다시보는 속기록 대한민국 정치사
programme.desc: 우리 민족은 기록에 관해서는 대단한 저력을 지니고 있다. 유네스코에 세계문화유산으로 지정된 조선시대의 승정원일기가 그렇고 그 사초를 바탕으로 편찬한 조선왕조실록이 그렇다. 현대 의회 민주주의의 전당, 국회에도 이러한 기록에 있다. 국민의 대표기관인 국회의 의정활동을 낱낱이 기록하는 속기록이 바로 그것. 여의도 국회 30주년을 맞아 국회방송에서는 총 16부에 걸친 연작 다큐멘터리 다시보는 속기록연출 조정훈을 제작, 방송한다. 이 프로그램은 질곡의 대한민국 현대사를 국회 속기록이라는 프리즘을 통해 재조명하고, 우리에게 주는 질책과 교훈을 담아낼 계획이다.

programme.desc: 바다를 품에 안고, 세 끼를 찾아 다시 돌아온 세 남자. 가을과 겨울을 거쳐, 이번엔 여름의 어촌이다! 대가족을 꾸려 어촌으로 컴백한 잭슨과 함께해, 더욱 생기 넘치는 세끼 하우스. 싱그러운 여름을 맞이하는 무한 득량 가능한 비옥한 바다, 드넓은 갯벌, 바다내음 물씬 풍기는 목장까지! 작지만 있을 건 다 있는, 남해의 파라다이스 득량도! 그 속에서 새롭게 펼쳐지는 자급자족 바다목장 라이프. 하늘 아래 같은 음식은 없다! 잭슨 패밀리의 등장으로 더욱 다양하고 새로워진 세 남자의 삼시세끼. 비옥한 섬, 득량도에서 찾은 이들의 밥상은 과연? 고즈넉한 섬 한가운데에서 진정 느낄 수 있는 여름 제철 청량 라이프! 한낮 여름 태양보다 더 타오르는 이들의 열정으로 지어진 밥상과 특별할 것 없지만, 즐거움이 묻어나는 삼시세끼가 시작됩니다!

programme.title: 회랑정 살인사건
programme.desc: 화염에 휩싸인 그날, 진실과 마주하다. 훙예그룹 회장 가오광이의 살날이 얼마 남지 않았음을 안 가오 씨 집안사람들은 유산과 회사를 차지하기 위해 혈안이 된다. 자신의 유일한 혈육인 혼외 자식에게 유산을 물려주고 싶었던 가오광이는 장위안싱을 시켜 아들을 찾게 하고, 장위안싱은 청청을 찾아낸다. 장위안싱이 청청을 데려오기 위해 설득하는 사이 둘의 사랑은 깊어지고, 가오 씨 집안사람들은 새로운 상속자의 등장에 불편한 기색을 드러낸다. 어둠이 드리운 회랑정 호텔의 밤, 갑작스러운 화재가 발생해 장위안싱은 크게 다치고 청청은 생명의 위협을 받게 되는데...

programme.title: 회장님네 사람들

programme.title: 회랑정 살인사건
programme.desc: 화염에 휩싸인 그날, 진실과 마주하다. 훙예그룹 회장 가오광이의 살날이 얼마 남지 않았음을 안 가오 씨 집안사람들은 유산과 회사를 차지하기 위해 혈안이 된다. 자신의 유일한 혈육인 혼외 자식에게 유산을 물려주고 싶었던 가오광이는 장위안싱을 시켜 아들을 찾게 하고, 장위안싱은 청청을 찾아낸다. 장위안싱이 청청을 데려오기 위해 설득하는 사이 둘의 사랑은 깊어지고, 가오 씨 집안사람들은 새로운 상속자의 등장에 불편한 기색을 드러낸다. 어둠이 드리운 회랑정 호텔의 밤, 갑작스러운 화재가 발생해 장위안싱은 크게 다치고 청청은 생명의 위협을 받게 되는데...

programme.title: YTN 24
programme.desc: 뉴스 채널 YTN의 기본축을 이루는 뉴스 프로그램. 정확성과 속보성을 최대한 살려 최신 정보를 필요로하는 시청자들의 욕구를 만족시켜 준다. 특히 뉴스 휠 방식을 도입함으로써 그 날의 주요 뉴스와 함께 방송시간 직전까지 기자들이 송고한 최신 소식을 매시간 뉴스 편집에 반영함으로써 가장 생생한 소식을 시청자들에게 전달한다. 또 진행 중인 사건, 사고의 변화되는 상황을 그때 그때 전달해 뉴스에 대한 시청자들의 궁금증을 해소하고 전반적인 변화에 대한 시청자들의 이해를 돕는다.

programme.desc: 周律師是專門為香港黑道洗錢的中間人，為了獨吞一筆鉅額贓款，派出殺手對付美國來的客人大偉，經過一場激烈槍戰，大偉僥倖逃脱，錢箱卻不翼而飛退役警察游龍和律師余文慧意外被捲入這場風波並被誤認為是幕後黑手，為了證明清白，兩人在危險中攜手合作，與周律師展開一場驚天動地的對決

programme.title: 倚天屠龍記之魔教教主
programme.desc: 改編自金庸武俠小說倚天屠龍記父母雙亡的張無忌（李連杰飾）身中玄冥神掌，幸得明教聖女小昭（邱淑貞飾）相助，練成九陽神功與乾坤大挪移，爾後得悉蒙古郡主趙敏（張敏飾）欲殘殺明教之奸計，遂赴光明頂揭穿其陰謀，終成為明教教主

programme.title: 警察故事

programme.title: 捉妖記
programme.desc: 某天，一對神祕夫婦與懷有小妖王的妖后逃到永寧村，遇上了善良的天蔭以及降妖少女小嵐，天蔭更陰錯陽差下成為代理孕夫誕下小妖王胡巴葛千戶重金懸賞小妖王小嵐為了得到賞金，拉著天蔭展開了一段奇幻旅程可愛的小妖王胡巴出生，令天蔭和小嵐關係起了奇妙變化，同時也揭發了一個重大祕密

programme.title: 急凍行者上
programme.desc: 錦衣衛高手賀英奉皇帝之命前往天竺國曾歃血為盟的兄弟元龍聶虎和薩獒，在賀英歸來途中對他展開突襲，而一陣地動山搖引來巨大雪崩，將四人一併淹沒400年後，被意外解凍的賀英來到了現代社會，但聶虎薩獒元龍三人也相繼從冰封中解凍，他們為了各自的目的不停追捕賀英，四兄弟之間的秘密也相繼揭開

programme.title: 急凍行者下
programme.desc: 明朝將軍賀英阿狗與聶虎來到現在香港，經歷青馬大橋之戰，最終阿狗死去，而賀英與阿虎則被警方扣查從明朝來到現代的副警務署張一鳴帶走賀英與阿狗，藉賀英手上的時空金碟回到明朝，而賀英選擇回到桃源村的道路，卻影響了他與其他相關人等的往後命運

programme.title: 送院途中
programme.desc: 救護隊員馬志業堅持救人至上，時常不按規定行事；而跟著上司石Sir調職過來的王維，視晉升為工作的最大目標兩人理念背道而馳，在合作時互相產生許多矛盾然而屯門公路發生了嚴重事故，王維發現石Sir不顧傷患，一心只想搶到主導指揮權，轉而跟隨後到現場的馬志業指揮，二人齊心拯救傷者

programme.title: 門徒
programme.desc: 阿力用了八年時間，從一名小小的毒品批發商混到壟斷海洛英市場的莊家身旁，負責處理出貨及運輸工作多年以來阿力全心全意搜集完整販毒資料，但行事小心的莊家從未透露後來莊家萌生退休之意並意欲交棒給阿力接管，於是帶阿力到金三角，對阿力做出接棒前的最後試探，一場鬥智的過程，使阿力獲得莊家的絕對信任，阿力也漸漸掌控經營販毒的秘密

programme.title: 潛行
programme.desc: 時代在不斷前進，警方與毒販間的禁毒戰爭也面臨新的挑戰，隱蔽的暗網成為新一代毒品販售的溫床，而它的目標正是位於亞太中心的香港，一批重達4噸的毒品趁著超強颱風的掩護秘密入港，準備在網絡上展開狂歡式銷售，情況緊迫，警方必須找出掌控暗網的幕後老闆，只能將藏身已久的臥底警員推到前線，然而老闆的身份仍然成謎，臥底警員陷入危險之中，毒品網絡蠢蠢欲試，警方和犯罪集團陷入一場宿命般的對決

programme.title: 聖誕玫瑰
programme.desc: 下肢癱瘓的李靜是名醫周文瑄女兒的鋼琴老師李靜指控周文瑄在一次內診時性侵她，與自稱清白的周文瑄對簿公堂，周妻徐潔因媒體未審先判飽受煎熬，又忙著為丈夫找律師和出庭作證這起司法對決掀起人性與正義角力的羅生門，隨著一場場針鋒相對的辯論，浮出水面的真相竟遠不只是一起以愛為名的悲劇

programme.title: 法海：白蛇傳說
programme.desc: 藥師許仙採藥途中偶遇修煉千年的白蛇，一人一妖互許終身豈料白蛇卻在兩人飲酒慶祝後現出原形，遭不知情的許仙用法刀刺傷，且負傷離去許仙得知真相後悔恨不已，前往雷峰塔盜取仙草拯救白蛇，卻遭妖靈附身而被高僧法海帶往金山寺服下仙草功力倍增的白蛇怒闖金山寺想帶走許仙，與法海展開一場死鬥

programme.title: 九品芝麻官
programme.desc: 包龍星買了一個縣令官職，他愛上的美女秦氏卻嫁給一位富商數月後，戚秦氏因絕世美貌遭水師提督常昆之子常威染指，戚家當晚慘遭滅門，首要凶嫌戚秦氏被刑求入獄待秋後處斬包龍星則被迫拔官，淪落至一妓院做龜公，因緣際會結識微服出遊之皇帝，被封為八府巡按後回鄉重審此案，號稱白面包青天，終將常威就地正法，戚秦氏沈冤得雪

programme.title: 神話
programme.desc: 秦朝玉漱公主頻頻入夢，困擾著考古學家杰克，使他更醉心研究秦朝古物為解開夢境之謎，杰克來到西安的懸浮天宮，同時亦有各路高手為奪寶而來，天宮寶物被撬開，天空之城因而失去懸浮能力，成千上萬的兵馬俑從天而降，杰克受一股神秘力量牽引跳入萬丈瀑布睜開雙眼，出現的竟然是夢中人玉漱公主！

programme.title: 青面修羅
programme.desc: 因一塊藏寶銅片慘遭滅門的青面修羅齊君元，在神秘刺客組織離恨谷長大某日離恨谷受託奪取藏寶銅片，谷主卻未派齊君元追查，但齊君元決意復仇，不惜叛谷暗自出馬調查血案消失多年的銅片為何再現？面對各路高手追殺捲入兩國鬥爭，齊君元發現自己已身陷局中，設局者是何方神聖？神秘委託人又是何許人也？

programme.title: 狄仁傑之四大天王

programme.title: 十月圍城
programme.desc: 1905年，香港在英國人統轄之下已度過數十個年頭，並被定名為維多利亞城華人依然佔人口極大比數，一方面保存了清朝的生活面貌，另一方面又受到西方文化的極大衝擊城中的華藉紳商，漸漸擁有財富與勢力，他們深明在英國政府管轄下，若不主動爭取，將會處處受制，但腐敗顢頇的滿清政府亦無法取得他們的信任於是，他們將希望寄託在滿懷理想，誓要推翻滿清政府的革命黨人身上

programme.title: 焚城
programme.desc: 一場意外引發輻射洩漏，全香港命運危在旦夕為應付這場毀滅性災難，專家范偉立加入緊急危機應變小組，消防隊臨危受命深入輻射區，拼死阻止輻射擴散全港，面對前所未見的末日浩劫，香港會否一夜滅城？

programme.title: 黑暗魔書
programme.desc: 一名私家偵探讀了一本來歷險惡的書，不知不覺中讓他和他的女兒陷入了為生命以及靈魂而戰的境地

programme.title: 致命遺產
programme.desc: 和父親斷聯許久的貝拉剛假釋出獄，接到父親好友艾德告知父親已經過世，並留給她一艘豪華遊艇前去領取父親最後禮物的貝拉，在酒吧裡邂逅了天菜麥可，一夕間猶如美夢成真！此時遊艇卻遭到兩名不速之客入侵，貝拉轉眼身陷巨大危機，在大海中退無可無退的她，不得不為生存而戰，並挖掘出謎樣父親的秘密

programme.title: 黑豹救援軍
programme.desc: 二戰期間，喬治巴頓將軍帶領著他的第三支美軍一路越過法國邊境，殺進納粹德國希特勒為了攔阻敵軍前進，出動了秘密武器Me262戰鬥機一場空中大戰隨即展開弗蘭克羅斯中尉駕駛著這場空戰的其中一架美軍戰機，眼看已敵不過納粹的猛烈襲擊，只好迫降在敵軍陣地內，在等待援兵的同時，非裔駕駛坦克前來營救為了贏得這場戰爭，他們必須將種族差異擱置一邊

programme.title: 野性獵殺
programme.desc: 特種部隊退役的法蘭克以販賣野生動物為業，某日他在巴西捕獲了一隻兇猛罕見的白色美洲豹沒想到船運過程中，碰上美國國安局正押解危險重刑犯洛夫勒，洛夫勒逃脫國安局的監控，並釋放船上所有的野生動物，法蘭克必須設法活捉美洲豹，還得協助美國政府捉拿洛夫勒，一場船上惡戰即將展開

programme.title: 危機倒數
programme.desc: 美伊戰爭時期，被派至伊拉克擔任拆彈隊長的詹姆斯雖然經驗老到，在一次任務中卻因他的堅持，意外讓隊友們陷入死亡絕境，小隊中開始出現反彈聲浪不久後的一場突襲任務出現一名自殺炸彈客，詹姆斯才意識到，自己的一舉一動將無法逆轉地改變身邊每一個人的命運；命懸一線的隊員，該如何從全世界最危險的戰地平安回家？榮獲奧斯卡最佳影片及最佳導演等六項大獎

programme.title: 獵空計畫
programme.desc: 育有一兒一女與妻子共組完美家庭的空軍中校歐列格，以及即將與妻子迎接新生命的空軍上尉康斯坦丁性格和生活截然不同的兩人，因為政府的決定，共同被派駐至敘利亞的空軍基地執行任務兩人在戰場上合作無間立下功勳，卻在一次摧毀敵方火箭發射器的行動中，因不慎掉入敵方的陷阱，兩人雖然逃過一劫但也性命垂危

programme.title: 守龍者
programme.desc: 自古相傳，應龍族保護風調雨順，而守龍者和他們命運相連，現世僅剩被囚禁的兩條龍與最後一個守龍者萍，為了拯救倉鼠夥伴，萍深入洞穴，與丹紫露雨的相遇意外解開她的真實身份守龍者能量覺醒，萍也收到嚴峻的任務：將最後一顆龍蛋送往育龍潭孵化，一人一龍的冒險成長之旅就此開啟

programme.title: 靈犬雪麗
programme.desc: 男孩小恩與爺爺住在阿爾卑斯山上一天，村民認為有隻流浪大白熊犬咬死羊隻，準備驅離牠，純真的小恩深信牠不是兇手，不僅挺身而出保護牠，更幫牠命名雪麗，一人一狗成為最佳拍檔，形影不離直到納粹德軍來到山上，雪麗因為小恩竟咬傷德軍，村民決定殺死牠小恩和雪麗能否逃過一劫，繼續守護彼此呢？

programme.title: 絕命3小時
programme.desc: 曾是歷史地標的堡高醫院，荒廢已久並面臨即將拆除的命運，但某幫派卻在此藏了九千萬，隨著消息傳開，兩個敵對黑幫虎視眈眈，想要找出這筆贓款，未料卻被拆除工人麥可搶先發現，而距離建物爆破拆除期限僅剩短短三小時

programme.title: 即刻救援
programme.desc: 退休特務布萊恩在與赴歐洲旅遊的愛女小琴通越洋電話時，親耳聽到小琴慘遭人口販子綁架，最強老爸將憑藉特務經驗及施展過人身手，追擊人口販子並親自救回掌上明珠！

programme.title: 黑獄戰場
programme.desc: 為了替遭殘忍謀殺的家人復仇，傑克不顧自己警察身分，精心策畫一宗銀行搶案，讓自己被送進兇手巴拉姆所在的監獄但傑克入獄後才發現，巴拉姆早已掌握整座監獄的運作，在牢中享有帝王般的待遇，更受到獄方層層保護，而巴拉姆得知傑克入獄，也派出殺手欲置傑克於死地，正當孤立無援的傑克無計可施之時，FBI臥底威廉提出兩人聯手對抗巴拉姆的計畫究竟威廉真正的意圖為何？傑克又能否殺出重圍，一償復仇宿願？

programme.title: 致命彈片
programme.desc: 前海軍陸戰隊員與他的老戰友槓上墨西哥販毒集團，試圖找出失蹤女兒的下落

programme.title: 攔劫計劃
programme.desc: 琳賽遭到丈夫虐待，因而夥同閨蜜妮可，決定向丈夫展開復仇，計劃奪取所有財產後南向逃亡展開新生活但隨著當地偵探循線追查，他們的友誼也變得岌岌可危

programme.title: 賭場大劫殺
programme.desc: 強尼和克萊德這兩位連環殺手瘋狂地愛上了對方，並一同犯下多起案件艾蓮娜既自信又狡猾，她經營的賭場每年賺進幾十億美金強尼和克萊德決定招集一群由罪犯和邊緣人組成的團隊來搶艾蓮娜的賭場然而，強尼和克萊德所不知道的是，艾蓮娜的手邊握有一個名叫霸克王的致命武器

programme.title: 父愁者聯盟
programme.desc: 亞圖卡雷尤蘇夫，三位截然不同的父親，卻有一個共通點－－三人的女兒都被愛情沖昏頭！安托妮亞因為瘋狂迷戀政治運動者，而把原訂的婚禮取消；露娜則愛上一位裸體攝影師；蘇菲更為一位毒販頻頻翹課三位無計可施的老爸，只好暗地結為盟友，決心為女兒的幸福不擇手段花招盡出，誓言要逼退這群壞小子！

programme.title: 玩命左輪
programme.desc: 傑克是個逢賭必勝的職業賭徒，讓賭場與對手聞之喪膽他與擔任會計的兄弟比利接到賭場老闆馬恰的邀約，天不怕地不怕的傑克，不但狠狠贏了馬恰一把，還在牌桌上羞辱馬恰，令顏面盡失的馬恰祭出追殺令此時傑克卻被醫生診斷出只剩三天壽命的怪病，而兩個殺手為了保護資產反倒成了保鏢，傑克要如何利用剩餘的時間和手上的爛牌完成最後奇招？

programme.title: 終極殺陣2：雷霆霹靂
programme.desc: 飆速計程車重現江湖啦！丹尼爾初次與岳父母共進午餐，適逢日本國防部長出訪法國，身為國防部長的岳父必須親自到機場迎接，丹尼爾的首要任務就是在飛機降落之前將岳父平安送達機場不料順利完成任務後，警探好友艾米里再度擾局，原來日本國防部長竟被恐怖份子綁架了！為了搶救日本國防部長並挽回法國的國際形象，艾米里只好再度請出飛車駕駛丹尼爾協助破案！

programme.title: 終極殺陣3
programme.desc: 12月的馬賽街頭，新式搶匪聖誕老公公肆虐，前兩集僥倖成功的響尾蛇和忍者行動，讓到處出包的警察局長又發想了新的無厘頭計畫，霹靂計程車司機丹尼爾添了更瘋狂的高科技新配備，準備和烏龍警探艾米里聯手衝向地中海飆上阿爾卑斯山，與難纏的聖誕搶匪們軋出個勝負；就在此時性感神秘的中國女子秋出現了！感情即將開花結果的艾米里，是否也因此陷入了意想不到的桃色危機？！

programme.title: 終極殺陣：最後衝刺
programme.desc: 隨著孩子出生長大家計吃緊，廢材警探艾米里決定接下史上最艱難的任務－－押解國際恐怖份子到南非，不得不求助老拍檔丹尼爾共度難關正當兩人認真商討對策時，小兔崽子們也沒閒著，闖禍本領更勝老爸，蠟燭兩頭燒的兩人，這下不僅要身兼奶爸，還要阻止法國淪為國際笑柄！

programme.title: 即刻救援
programme.desc: 退休特務布萊恩在與赴歐洲旅遊的愛女小琴通越洋電話時，親耳聽到小琴慘遭人口販子綁架，最強老爸將憑藉特務經驗及施展過人身手，追擊人口販子並親自救回掌上明珠！

programme.title: 伯尼小海豚
programme.desc: 凱文和荷莉是一對熱愛海洋生態的兄妹檔一次的落水意外讓他們邂逅了海豚伯尼，彼此逐漸建立深厚的情感伯尼是一隻落單的海豚，凱文和荷莉決定盡一切努力幫助這隻海豚朋友回到家人的懷抱同時，他們也發現一名不懷好意的房地產開發商正悄悄收購土地，大肆破壞海灣的生態，只為了建造海洋公園，於是兄妹倆決定急中生智，展開一場生態保衛戰

programme.title: 伯尼小海豚2
programme.desc: 海洋中最聰明機伶的海豚伯尼又回來了！伯尼和他的夥伴們回到了熟悉的海灣，凱文和荷莉兄妹檔將注意力轉移到海洋救援站的新海豚小淘氣身上；同時，陰險的惡棍溫斯頓也從監獄被釋放出來，並暗中策劃邪惡的復仇計畫兄妹檔和小海豚伯尼將再次聯手捍衛海洋生態！

programme.title: 冰血殺機
programme.desc: 美國鑽石商人盧卡斯前往俄羅斯進行交易卻因故告吹，搭檔也人間蒸發盧卡斯與西伯利亞咖啡館的女店長卡提雅萌生情愫，在危機四伏的鑽石交易市場裡，兩人要如何安然逃離凶險的西伯利亞？

programme.title: 安娜
programme.desc: 盧貝松動作驚悚新作，地表最強女殺神誕生！一名謎樣女子，臥底黑白兩道，彈無虛發懲治惡徒，是當今世界上最令人恐懼的政府刺客在引人注目的美麗之下，深埋著極大秘密，眾人只知道她的名字叫：安娜

programme.title: 死神騎馬來
programme.desc: 十五年前的梅斯塔牧場，比爾一家人慘遭搶匪集團滅門，只有小比爾被一名晚到搶匪藏於馬車下而逃過一劫親眼目睹家人慘死的比爾，多年來苦練槍法一心復仇，在追查的過程中遇上甫出獄的中年牛仔瑞恩，兩人似乎有著共同的目標，帶著既像競爭又像合作的方式將匪徒逐一揪出擊斃，而比爾也漸漸發現瑞恩其實隱藏著一段秘密

programme.title: 父親
programme.desc: 罹患失智症的安東尼，隨著年齡增長，他所認知的世界與現實逐漸產生差距即使充滿疑惑，他卻無法接受自己患病的事實，更拒絕女兒安所安排的一切協助與照顧隨著病情急轉直下，他逐漸遺忘時間空間，甚至是自己摯愛的親人

programme.title: A計劃
programme.desc: 二十世紀初期，香港海盜橫行，盜魁羅三炮與奸商周永齡互相勾結，官府為之束手水警沙展馬如龍不滿官府政策憤而辭職，與道上名賊卓一飛合謀對付海盜，惜卓一飛唯利是圖，二人合作屢剿失利馬如龍心有不甘，遂重新加入水師警隊，與上司洪天賜卓一飛三人合力喬裝闖入匪巢，終將海盜一網打盡

programme.title: A計劃續集
programme.desc: 開埠初期的香港之上環中環西環由有鎮三環之稱的鄭幫辦管制，鎮三環暗中勾結西環惡霸歐心虎，令治安一時烏煙瘴氣警官馬如龍奉命接管西環後速將歐心虎拘捕入獄，因而招致鎮三環的怨恨當時中國革命風雲翻湧，革命黨人來港宣傳並計劃營救被捕同志為將革命黨人一網打盡，清廷派遣密使聯絡鎮三環，馬如龍與結識的一干革命黨人隨後也被捲入鬥爭漩渦與此同時，一群四肢發達頭腦簡單的海盜餘黨正伺機向馬如龍報仇

programme.title: 爆破死亡谷
programme.desc: 二戰後期，已節節敗退的納粹德國為求反敗為勝，希特勒下令全力發展秘密報復性武器倫敦方面由於情報有限，軍方於是啟動十字弓計畫，選派具語言與科學專長的人員訓練為特工，潛入德國地下工廠蒐集情資當一連串的未知武器輪番來襲造成英國軍民一片恐慌，盟軍的一切希望就寄託在這些特工身上！

programme.title: 金玉良緣紅樓夢
programme.desc: 京城裡的世家大族賈府中，賈家公子賈寶玉與表妹林黛玉相戀，但為家長所不容賈家設計瞞騙寶玉，讓其娶了金陵薛家的女兒薛寶釵黛玉誤以為寶玉移情別戀，傷心不已，悽然病逝乃至寶玉得知真相，但與愛人已陰陽兩隔，肝腸寸斷，萬念俱灰，遂遁入空門

programme.title: 狂沙十萬里
programme.desc: 冷血殺手法蘭克神秘復仇客口琴仔美麗寡婦吉兒盜賊頭頭夏安，四人各為不同理由原因來到這處鐵路即將開通的西部荒漠甜水鎮鐵路大亨莫頓為取得鐵道用地，在甜水鎮大興風浪，在現代鐵路西進的歷史洪流中，上演新一輪腥風血雨的美國西部開拓史

programme.title: 威龍闖天關
programme.desc: 清朝道光至咸豐年間，廣州名狀師宋世傑為求生計，專替有罪富人打官司脫罪，巧言善辯顛倒是非，因而遭天譴，與心地善良卻潑辣正義的妻子屢次喪子封筆從善後，宋在妻子感召下重出江湖，為寡婦楊秀珍仗義伸冤，在官官相衛下，夫妻聯手機智辯案，揭穿黑幕，終令惡人伏法，善有善報，兒孫滿堂

programme.title: 教父
programme.desc: 二戰後的紐約黑手黨柯里昂家族，是以賭博走私和操控工會的黑幫企業，首領維多嚴守傳統黑幫道德準則，拒絕販售敗壞人心的毒品被人尊為教父而其他黑手黨家族為謀求更高利益的毒品生意，希望在警政界具影響力的維多加入經營被拒後，一場腥風血雨的黑幫血拚暗殺，正襲向維多的柯里昂家族

programme.title: 上海灘
programme.desc: 1930年代的上海，熱血愛國青年許文強因故身陷囹圄，出獄後隻身闖蕩上海，在一次意外中結識了生死之交丁力兩人發誓要在上海黑幫闖出一片天，卻同時捲入了上海大亨馮敬堯的家族鬥爭

programme.title: 水滸傳
programme.desc: 梁山好漢首領晁蓋攻打曾頭市時，不幸被史文恭毒箭射身亡為替他報仇並制衡史文恭，梁山派員游說富豪盧俊義入伙盧俊義卻遭管家陷害入獄；經梁山群俠全力劫法場救出盧後，眾人合力攻破曾頭市，史文恭眼見大勢已去最終自盡，全片洋溢悲壯的英雄豪情

programme.title: 蕩寇誌
programme.desc: 梁山好漢接受朝廷招安後，奉命南下征討方臘大軍攻打杭州城，石秀史進李逵等人相繼苦戰犧牲杭州城外，燕青力戰南方相撲高手司行方，返回梁山伯大營大軍計畫以湧金門為突破口進攻杭州，武松等將領率軍攻城，討伐方臘終成替天行道大業

programme.title: 荒野一匹狼
programme.desc: 南北戰爭結束不久後的美墨邊境小鎮外，一位拖著棺材漫步在泥濘荒野上的浪人姜戈，解救了一名原將被處以火刑的美麗女子瑪麗亞在這目無法紀的鎮上有著二股惡勢力，隨著姜戈偕瑪麗亞重回小鎮，是否將掀起更大的腥風血雨？而姜戈背後拖著的棺材裡又裝著什麼秘密？

programme.title: 馬永貞
programme.desc: 馬永貞和大哥一起離開家鄉闖蕩上海灘，因一身義膽豪情而受當地大老譚四爺所賞識，後偶遇歌女金鈴子並互生情愫，幾人在動盪的上海灘歷經江湖險惡，最終夢醒還鄉

programme.title: 黃飛鴻之鐵雞鬥蜈蚣
programme.desc: 黃飛鴻結識尋找妹妹的鐵燕父女，鐵燕父女發現朝廷的捕快正和僧人在商議販賣人口的計策但不料行蹤被發現，結果父親被打傷，女兒只好逃出去向黃飛鴻求救

programme.title: 633轟炸大隊
programme.desc: 二戰期間，挪威反抗軍領袖艾利克冒死劫機逃至英國，帶來德軍在挪威秘密研發飛彈準備對盟軍展開致命攻擊的情報英軍命令格蘭特指揮官的蚊式戰鬥轟炸機633中隊，執行摧毀德軍隱身在挪威險峻峽灣飛彈工廠的任務艾利克奉命返回挪威帶領反抗軍破壞保護工廠的防空陣地，卻不幸被蓋世太保所擄並遭嚴刑拷問；消息傳回英國，為避免任務曝光急命633中隊全員出動救援

programme.title: 威龍闖天關
programme.desc: 清朝道光至咸豐年間，廣州名狀師宋世傑為求生計，專替有罪富人打官司脫罪，巧言善辯顛倒是非，因而遭天譴，與心地善良卻潑辣正義的妻子屢次喪子封筆從善後，宋在妻子感召下重出江湖，為寡婦楊秀珍仗義伸冤，在官官相衛下，夫妻聯手機智辯案，揭穿黑幕，終令惡人伏法，善有善報，兒孫滿堂

programme.title: 馬永貞
programme.desc: 馬永貞和大哥一起離開家鄉闖蕩上海灘，因一身義膽豪情而受當地大老譚四爺所賞識，後偶遇歌女金鈴子並互生情愫，幾人在動盪的上海灘歷經江湖險惡，最終夢醒還鄉

programme.title: 現在開始是Showtime！
programme.desc: 操縱幻術的魔術師朴海鎮 通靈女警秦基周，靈異喜劇Showtime！！神秘又搞怪的魔術師車次雄，不僅能操縱幻術，還能使喚鬼魂，這群幽靈助手是他的得力夥伴熱血女警高瑟海，擁有通靈能力，她對靈異現象毫不畏懼兩人因一起調查超自然案件而結盟，一邊與鬼神合作，一邊大展魔術與正義力量當喜劇靈異與調查結合，愛情與真相也心動牽引

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 李昇基韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子 高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星

programme.title: 沒關係，是愛情啊
programme.desc: 長腿男神趙寅成電視劇女王孔曉振 小說家與精神科醫師的心靈救贖人氣推理小說家張宰烈，表面風光，內心卻深陷思覺失調的困境；精神科醫師池海秀，冷靜理智，卻無法觸碰愛情的傷口在一場火花四射的電視對談後，兩人意外成為室友張宰烈以鋒利的直覺揭開海秀男友的背叛，並逐步探知她拒絕親密接觸的秘密；海秀則用專業的敏銳洞悉宰烈隱藏的內心裂縫當兩個帶著傷痕的人，在彼此的世界中摸索，療癒與愛情悄然交織，他們將走出各自的黑暗，擁抱一段治癒心靈的深情羈絆

programme.title: 不插電露營
programme.desc: 不插電的戶外實境節目，重新找回心的連結！！充滿冒險與成長的戶外實境節目，由侯彥西陳妤帶領一群新人演員，拋開日常科技，踏上從心出發的旅程山林間的挑戰露營體驗等，讓成員彼此扶持坦誠交流，重新找回與人相處的真實感動每一次困難互助，都化作心靈的充電，讓旅行不只是冒險，更是成長與情感的累積，他們成為彼此的行動電源，燃亮內心最真摯的力量與溫暖

programme.title: 女人要有錢
programme.desc: 知名女作家吳淡如，以她知性且深入人心的形象，攜手專業寶物鑑定團隊，帶領觀眾走進藝人名人貴婦及素人家中，鑑賞他們珍藏的寶物及收藏品節目將通過生動的賞寶過程，向觀眾傳授基礎的賞寶知識，讓大家在輕鬆愉快的氛圍中，學會如何鑑定家中的寶物究竟這些珍藏能否讓你一夜致富，還是讓你瞬間崩盤？敬請鎖定，一同探索古今寶物的奧秘！

programme.title: 現在開始是Showtime！首
programme.desc: 操縱幻術的魔術師朴海鎮 通靈女警秦基周，靈異喜劇Showtime！！神秘又搞怪的魔術師車次雄，不僅能操縱幻術，還能使喚鬼魂，這群幽靈助手是他的得力夥伴熱血女警高瑟海，擁有通靈能力，她對靈異現象毫不畏懼兩人因一起調查超自然案件而結盟，一邊與鬼神合作，一邊大展魔術與正義力量當喜劇靈異與調查結合，愛情與真相也心動牽引

programme.title: 健康新發現
programme.desc: 健康新發現

programme.title: 沒關係，是愛情啊
programme.desc: 長腿男神趙寅成電視劇女王孔曉振 小說家與精神科醫師的心靈救贖人氣推理小說家張宰烈，表面風光，內心卻深陷思覺失調的困境；精神科醫師池海秀，冷靜理智，卻無法觸碰愛情的傷口在一場火花四射的電視對談後，兩人意外成為室友張宰烈以鋒利的直覺揭開海秀男友的背叛，並逐步探知她拒絕親密接觸的秘密；海秀則用專業的敏銳洞悉宰烈隱藏的內心裂縫當兩個帶著傷痕的人，在彼此的世界中摸索，療癒與愛情悄然交織，他們將走出各自的黑暗，擁抱一段治癒心靈的深情羈絆

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 李浚赫化身金家小兒子 婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 不插電露營新
programme.desc: 不插電的戶外實境節目，重新找回心的連結！！充滿冒險與成長的戶外實境節目，由侯彥西陳妤帶領一群新人演員，拋開日常科技，踏上從心出發的旅程山林間的挑戰露營體驗等，讓成員彼此扶持坦誠交流，重新找回與人相處的真實感動每一次困難互助，都化作心靈的充電，讓旅行不只是冒險，更是成長與情感的累積，他們成為彼此的行動電源，燃亮內心最真摯的力量與溫暖

programme.title: 女人要有錢
programme.desc: 知名女作家吳淡如，以她知性且深入人心的形象，攜手專業寶物鑑定團隊，帶領觀眾走進藝人名人貴婦及素人家中，鑑賞他們珍藏的寶物及收藏品節目將通過生動的賞寶過程，向觀眾傳授基礎的賞寶知識，讓大家在輕鬆愉快的氛圍中，學會如何鑑定家中的寶物究竟這些珍藏能否讓你一夜致富，還是讓你瞬間崩盤？敬請鎖定，一同探索古今寶物的奧秘！

programme.title: 男朋友
programme.desc: 韓版羅馬假期 霸總宋慧喬戀上暖男朴寶劍 出身政客家庭的車秀賢，為了家族犧牲愛情步入無愛的婚姻，離婚後的人生空虛蒼白；金振赫是懷抱夢想的平凡青年，用熱情擁抱世界兩人在異國邂逅，相知相愛，卻因身分懸殊而痛苦分離多年後重逢，她已是冷靜自持的上司，他是剛入職的新進員工過往的甜蜜與傷痕浮現，情感再度悄然蔓延她掙扎於曾經的選擇，他則努力衝破階級的枷鎖愛情，能否再次在現實的夾縫中綻放？

programme.title: 我親愛的朋友們
programme.desc: 老人也有春天！七十歲的我們終於學會說不她們是一群走過風雨的老人，曾為家庭默默奉獻，如今選擇為自己綻放一場聚會重新牽起年少情誼，也掀開多年壓抑的心事有人鼓起勇氣離婚，搬進夢想中的小屋；有人在意外後學會面對過錯，重拾友情的信任；有人對抗失智，卻仍記得朋友的名字與笑聲女兒朴莞在傾聽中理解母親，在書寫中記錄她們的光芒人生未晚，她們手牽著手，用皺紋寫下溫柔，也用笑聲走向嶄新的旅程

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 渣男律師劈腿富豪千金 李敏英逆襲成知名設計師恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福

programme.title: 逆轉女王
programme.desc: 經典韓劇賢內助女王姊妹作黃泰熙原是高薪的開發組長，但為了追求幸福家庭，她選擇與新同事奉俊秀結婚然而她的決定，卻讓她被信任的女上司趕出公司，只能在家當賢內助五年後，泰熙感到現實生活的沉重，決定重返職場在公司她遇見了具勇植，一位支持她的本部長泰熙在勇植的鼓勵下展現出更堅韌的一面，最終成功東山再起，找到了新的事業目標

programme.desc: 經典韓劇賢內助女王姊妹作黃泰熙原是高薪的開發組長，但為了追求幸福家庭，她選擇與新同事奉俊秀結婚然而她的決定，卻讓她被信任的女上司趕出公司，只能在家當賢內助五年後，泰熙感到現實生活的沉重，決定重返職場在公司她遇見了具勇植，一位支持她的本部長泰熙在勇植的鼓勵下展現出更堅韌的一面，最終成功東山再起，找到了新的事業目標

programme.title: 男朋友
programme.desc: 韓版羅馬假期 霸總宋慧喬戀上暖男朴寶劍 出身政客家庭的車秀賢，為了家族犧牲愛情步入無愛的婚姻，離婚後的人生空虛蒼白；金振赫是懷抱夢想的平凡青年，用熱情擁抱世界兩人在異國邂逅，相知相愛，卻因身分懸殊而痛苦分離多年後重逢，她已是冷靜自持的上司，他是剛入職的新進員工過往的甜蜜與傷痕浮現，情感再度悄然蔓延她掙扎於曾經的選擇，他則努力衝破階級的枷鎖愛情，能否再次在現實的夾縫中綻放？

programme.title: 我親愛的朋友們
programme.desc: 老人也有春天！七十歲的我們終於學會說不她們是一群走過風雨的老人，曾為家庭默默奉獻，如今選擇為自己綻放一場聚會重新牽起年少情誼，也掀開多年壓抑的心事有人鼓起勇氣離婚，搬進夢想中的小屋；有人在意外後學會面對過錯，重拾友情的信任；有人對抗失智，卻仍記得朋友的名字與笑聲女兒朴莞在傾聽中理解母親，在書寫中記錄她們的光芒人生未晚，她們手牽著手，用皺紋寫下溫柔，也用笑聲走向嶄新的旅程

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 渣男律師劈腿富豪千金 李敏英逆襲成知名設計師恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福

法國西岸滋味遊英
programme.desc: 紀爾恩帶觀眾深入布列塔尼那凱爾特的靈魂與航海之心從貝隆的河流迷宮，到格魯瓦島的捕魚傳統，他會發掘當地與海洋的淵源，品嘗最美味的海鮮一起踏上美食之旅，欣賞布列塔尼的豐富味道與傳統

programme.title: 貼地鐵路遊英
programme.desc: 米高在美國最南端的火車站展開火車之旅，目的地是最北端的車站，在美國最南端的佛州基韋斯特開始，搭火車北上，乘搭該州最新式及最古老的火車

programme.title: 穹蒼下的城堡英
programme.desc: 斯洛伐克遍地岩石高山和河流，以及居高臨下守護國土的堡壘要塞這裏的城堡絕不隱蔽，而是傲然屹立於天空之下今集將會觀賞懸崖邊緣的廢墟哥德式堡壘瞭望塔和神話宮殿

programme.title: 我要做廚神 : 澳洲篇英
programme.desc: 十強面對另一個黑圍裙日. 嘉賓評判美琪比爾帶來喜歡的食材. 參賽者獲派一對材料, 可以用見到的食材入饌, 亦可選擇蓋子下面的食材. 結果只有一個參賽者賭一局. 表現最遜色的三個人, 將會進入第二回合.

programme.title: 我要做廚神 : 澳洲篇英
programme.desc: 安東尼奧要用卡拉馬塔橄欖煮菜, 德倫要用葛縷子, 瑪麗莎則要用葡萄乾. 除了德倫, 另外兩人對食材不太滿意. 然而他們全力以赴. 期間各人遇到困難, 要急急補救. 最後, 一位有才華廚師給淘汰.

programme.title: 狗狗老友記英
programme.desc: 獲救小雞的體重比獲救芝娃娃還要重但這沒有阻止牠倆建立跨物種情誼，這種情誼幫助牠倆在一個迷你動物收容所中健康成長一隻獲救浣熊成為家裡的公主，也是牠的朋友和保護者一隻名叫窩夫的狗最喜歡的玩伴

programme.title: 法國西岸滋味遊英
programme.desc: 紀爾恩帶觀眾深入布列塔尼那凱爾特的靈魂與航海之心從貝隆的河流迷宮，到格魯瓦島的捕魚傳統，他會發掘當地與海洋的淵源，品嘗最美味的海鮮一起踏上美食之旅，欣賞布列塔尼的豐富味道與傳統

programme.title: 節拍小天地英
programme.desc: 和Monica一起投入節拍小天地她利用環保回收箱中收集的日常物品，自製手工藝樂器專業音樂家和少年樂手會到節拍小天地中即興表演他們的樂器是Monica製作的手工藝樂器的靈感來源

programme.title: 台慶鉅獻:野性王國英
programme.desc: 一位當地攝影師拍攝偷吃農作物的大象，反盜獵隊借助搜查犬打擊犯罪從使用辣椒彈的快速應變部隊，到搜尋致命陷阱和槍支的巡邏員，這些幕後英雄的故事講述他們為保護贊比亞野生動物而進行的永無止境的鬥爭

programme.title: 優遊假期英
programme.desc: 今集兩位大廚嘉倫和加利結伴去歐洲度暑假首先去伊斯坦布爾，入住當地的萊佛士酒店然後二人登上銀海郵輪公司最新的郵輪銀海光輝號，暢遊希臘群島

programme.title: 七點半新聞報道英
programme.desc: 明珠台每日晚上七時半，以英語報道本地兩岸及國際重要新聞，讓你洞悉各地大事

programme.title: 動物宅急便英
programme.desc: 今集要把重兩公噸的南方白犀牛，從澳洲首都坎培拉國家公園，運回格蘭坪山的霍爾斯峽谷動物園車程九個半小時，越過兩條州界，還要在濃霧之中通宵行車

programme.title: 野性大追捕英
programme.desc: 有些動物建造的巢穴或地下通道絕不簡單，需要複雜的大腦或非凡的進化歷程，方能設計出陷阱這般的獵食機制，甚少物種能夠建造和發展出迷惑並殺害其他生物的裝備

programme.desc: 萧十一郎被人冒名作恶，送割鹿刀托连城璧杀萧宝刀途中被轩辕无敌夺去轩欲强抢美女沈璧君，萧英雄救美萧行踪败露，被连伏击重伤，幸为沈所救萧决意将宝刀取回...

programme.title: 镖旗飞扬
programme.desc: 凌霄及关望龙同为一流镖师，深得主人器重关单恋主人孙女方燕，方却情系于凌关迁怒凌，竟与黑道中人金不换密谋劫镖，嫁祸凌...

programme.title: 没有老公的日子
programme.desc: 黄太太独力抚养儿子Alex成人，与媳妇阿彤一起生活岂料Alex意外逝世，死前道出外遇女友黑仔已怀有身孕结果三名没有老公的女人同住一室...

programme.title: 群英会
programme.desc: 本片由三个单元故事组成，为岳枫程刚及张彻联合执导，当年就有花一张票价，看三套电影的称誉岳枫之铁弓缘讲述一对青年男女因一把铁弓而结缘程刚之胭脂虎讲述一群绝色妓女的故事张彻之白水滩讲述梁山英雄后代的故事

programme.title: 夺魂铃
programme.desc: 故事描述，少年卫虎家遭左景龙应天与杨刚所洗劫，父母幼弟被杀，姐卫芸被左劫走，顿时家破人亡虎愤恨万状，放火烧毁家园，决心远走天涯，找寻仇人报复；虎流浪各地，遇隐名大侠士，投拜为师，数年即习艺有成，遂往找仇人；虎抵鸡儿镇，遇弱女香香遭逼为娼，逐出手相助，击退歹徒...

programme.title: 至尊一剑
programme.desc: 魔山派秦五新剑术高超，连败九十九名剑手，终在最后一击败在剑神手上五新知其欠缺一柄宝剑，遂杀死著名铸剑师老鹰，夺取稀世的老鹰宝剑老鹰之子燕北悲痛万分，矢誓报仇，不自量力挑战五新，结果被打落悬崖之下...

programme.title: 奸人鬼
programme.desc: 男孩小吉的父母离异后，希望寻找快乐的人生一天，小吉喜遇好心鬼简人，并结成好友好心鬼决定要帮助小吉的父母复合，令小吉得到真正的快乐

programme.desc: 戴顾东夏雨经营的茶餐厅受金融风暴牵连陷入财困，急需资金周转，不知内情的叶慕升许绍雄觊觎茶餐厅的铺位主动入股，顾东暂得援兵便埋头研制新菜式，谁料新请回来的散工崔喜喜商天娥炒了一碟蛋炒饭，深受米芝莲代表赏识，顾东对她宠爱有加一天，银行代表利蓉姿伍咏薇突然出现，喜喜因迷债事件与她大打出手，喜喜受伤失忆，顾东为保米芝莲星级声誉，安排所有人假装为喜喜的家人，自己是喜喜的大哥，慕升是丈夫，儿子是大提琴教师叶积良陈键锋，就连女儿戴莹莉唐诗咏也被迫由积良的女朋友变做表妹，关系乱七八糟，惹来连番笑话......麻烦事一浪接一浪，被银行辞退的蓉姿突然声称自己是茶餐厅的股东，要为茶餐厅作大改革；一家本来平凡不过的港式茶餐厅，突然三权分立，人人各怀鬼胎......

programme.title: 再生缘 第2集
programme.desc: 孟丽君叶璇父亲孟士元卢海鹏为前朝御医，饱学之士，却思想守旧，相信女子无才便是德君为求学问，女扮男装到书院读书君于四出游玩时结识了微服下江南的蒙古王孙铁穆耳马德钟及忠直少年皇甫少华林，三人结成兄弟耳看穿君女子的身份，却不道破；君对耳亦有好感元打算把君许配给世交皇甫家；与此同时，权贵刘奎璧张松枝亦向孟家提亲婚期迫在眉睫，君决定向耳表白爱意，惜耳因父病危要赶回京，将与君约会之事交托华君大为失望，并斥走华为着终身幸福，君带着侍婢离家出走君到处闯荡，因其男子之装扮而闹出不少笑话，亦牵涉入多宗惊险重重的事件中君其后分别与华及耳展开了两段若即若离的感情，更知道原来华便是与其有婚约的未婚夫，耳为皇族之后......

programme.title: 天涯侠医 第10集
programme.desc: 王甫芬医生张家辉为完成女友彤梁咏琪的遗愿而加入国际救援组织生命动力，其后更成立以平民为对象的龙城医疗中心芬随组织在肯尼亚工作时，认识了年轻的齐百恒林峰医生原本在私家医院凌霄医院任职的恒其后亦受芬影响而加入龙城芬以病人为先的精神不但感染了恒，亦叫在凌霄当护士的康乔郭羡妮心仪，可惜芬始终忘不了彤另方面，恒在非洲认识了义工夏晓晴唐宁，对她留下了深刻的印象；其后二人再在龙城相遇，惟晴却因恒身边的富家女高小柔陈敏之而却步恒跟随芬在龙城及生命动力工作，明白到医生除了医病亦能帮助病人活出生命的意义可能医者真的不能自医，助人无数的恒和芬在面对自己的人生挑战时，也有无助的时候......

programme.title: 香港人在北京 第18集
programme.desc: 物业管理公司高层徐港仁陈展鹏饰藉运气帮助，事业一帆风顺，却与太太邝海伦吴若希饰误堕投资骗局，损失惨重港仁获派往北京分公司出任CEO，视之为翻身机会，遂偕海伦北上发展，怎料遇中年危机港仁因昔日宿敌丁志强明升暗降，为面子被迫留守；他及后亦重遇多年不见的苏菲蔡洁饰，婚姻面临考验美食网红徐港文洪永城饰街头歌手徐宝怡戴祖仪饰各有原因北上投靠大哥港仁，一家人集思广益，想将废弃变压厂改造成文创园佛系主义的港仁，要认真为人生打场硬仗！

programme.title: 射鵰英雄传 第20集
programme.desc: 南宋中叶，郭杨两家无辜惨遭灭门，其后人各散东西，展开了一段不解的两代情仇郭家后人郭靖（张智霖）于大漠成长，为人正直坚毅，自小得江南七怪传授武艺一次南下江南，结识了精灵活脱的黄蓉（朱茵），二人展开了一段生死相许的感情及武林奇遇机缘巧合下，郭靖先后习得北丐洪七公（刘丹）之降龙十八掌及周伯通（黎耀祥）之武林绝学九阴真经，令郭靖之武艺大进那边厢，杨家后人杨康（罗嘉良）为金人完颜洪烈收养，贵为太子

programme.title: 那些我爱过的人 第16集
programme.desc: 七年前一宗严重车祸，破坏了两个家庭，改变了姜煜诚林文龙饰方乐汶黄翠如饰的人生七年后一次交通意外，让煜诚重遇乐汶，生活仍然有悲有喜乐汶与妹妹方书文连诗雅饰因身边人逐一离开而闹僵，没想到行为怪异的医生古希晨马贯东饰，却能直捣问题根源乐汶忙于照顾女儿朱幸而及继子朱嘉炳顾定轩饰，煜诚则一直未能了解独女姜子优苏皓儿饰的需要子优和嘉炳因缘走近，共同朋友莫宇谦李任燊饰竟为此段关系衍生更多问题，也令当年车祸真相渐渐浮现，众人亦要再次面临改变......

programme.title: 单恋双城 第4集
programme.desc: 任职旅行社的罗式适陈茵媺为公司开拓新业务，特赴马来西亚与客户开会，谁料被当地滑头导游陆恭梓陈展鹏破坏一切计划，二人因而结怨，式适的男朋友程展博杨明突然现身向她求婚...

programme.title: 状王之王 第15集
programme.desc: 满清年间，聪敏机灵的宋世杰王浩信饰因父亲宋安张达明饰是名狱吏，从小就游走于牢房内，见尽世间不平之事，令他不相信法律有公义世杰长大后亦不愿进官场，纵有真才实学，也只暗中相助同试考生何守信林子聪饰中举，他则偕兄弟宋阿九金刚饰浪游天下世杰及后却被卷进蜘蛛精杀人案中，他为寻真凶展示状师才华，期间更结识了武功高强的青楼护卫玲珑姚子羚饰......案件了结，世杰和玲珑结为夫妻，他亦正式踏上状师之路，还接连遇到一宗宗错综复杂的大案......

programme.title: 法外风云 第13集

programme.title: 状王之王 第15集
programme.desc: 满清年间，聪敏机灵的宋世杰王浩信饰因父亲宋安张达明饰是名狱吏，从小就游走于牢房内，见尽世间不平之事，令他不相信法律有公义世杰长大后亦不愿进官场，纵有真才实学，也只暗中相助同试考生何守信林子聪饰中举，他则偕兄弟宋阿九金刚饰浪游天下世杰及后却被卷进蜘蛛精杀人案中，他为寻真凶展示状师才华，期间更结识了武功高强的青楼护卫玲珑姚子羚饰......案件了结，世杰和玲珑结为夫妻，他亦正式踏上状师之路，还接连遇到一宗宗错综复杂的大案......

programme.title: 玫瑰的故事The Tale of Rose
programme.desc: 出生于书香世家的黄亦玫一路在呵护中长大，从小便展露出艺术天赋初入职场的黄亦玫很快受到重用，与合作伙伴庄国栋相识相爱，但最终错过彼此，这段职场磨炼也令她对自己的人生有了更清晰的规划，决定重返校园求学深造毕业后，她和学长方协文步入婚姻殿堂可婚后两人发展方向相去甚远，最 终选择离婚黄亦玫开始创业，在艺术品策展领域打拼出一片天地，在此期间还遇到了自己的灵魂伴侣溥家明，可溥家明只剩几个月的生命，两人这段爱情最终以生死离别画上句号 但黄亦玫没有就此消沉，她还是一如既往地为活出更精彩的自己而努力着

programme.title: 无可替代Irreplaceable
programme.desc: Driven by childhood trauma, Xu Chi vows to become irreplaceable. As she enters elite consulting, her talent quickly shines but a threatened mentor and a reunion with industry star Ye Xinzhi ignite a fierce new chapter.

programme.title: 无可替代Irreplaceable
programme.desc: Thrown into a brutal client dinner, Xu Chi proves she can think under pressure. When she boldly overturns her mentors failed pitch and wins the client, admiration turns into fear and their workplace rivalry explodes.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon Season 1
programme.desc: Set out on epic journeys guided by lunar forces. See how invisible signals guide whales and turtles along ocean migration routes, criss-cross continents with nightjar birds, and observe dung beetles and other insects that navigate by moonlight.

programme.title: The Kimberley: Australias Wild West Season 1
programme.desc: Avoid scaly and feathery dangers with wallabies, see koolamana lizards battle for mates, and feast with crocodile hatchlings. Brave dangerous rapids and understand the cultural and biological importance of a local river as the rainy season arrives.

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas Season 1
programme.desc: The African savanna is an epic landscape, and whether its head-bashing hippos, hormone-crazed elephants or dueling lions, battles that rage on the savanna are just as epic.

programme.title: Kenya Wildlife Diaries Season 1
programme.desc: Lewa Conservancy is working to return elephants to territory from Mt. Kenya to Samburu National Park. Theyve also created an elephant exclusion zone to try and restore a damaged ecosystem. Radio tracking collars are used for both initiatives to help conservationists better understand the elephants needs - and to see if theyre returning to their natural corridors.

programme.title: Undiscovered Vistas Season 2
programme.desc: Learn about the worlds largest volcanic island, a lone and rugged place where steam escapes, water explodes, and new ground is born every day. See how fire and ice collide in a battle that makes this the most geologically powerful island on earth.

programme.title: Undiscovered Vistas Season 2
programme.desc: Tour an island built by volcanoes, but sculpted by ice. About 1.5 million years ago, a sheet of ice descended from the north and covered the land. Today, massive glaciers continue to carve marine cliffs and cut down mountains.

programme.title: Undiscovered Vistas Season 2
programme.desc: Step into the Bay of Fundys surging waters. Learn how this east coast ecosystem sustains an abundance of creatures, including hundreds of thousands of seabirds, the worlds fastest predator, and a complex web of invertebrates.

programme.title: Undiscovered Vistas Season 2
programme.desc: Travel along the west coast of Great Britain, where the worlds longest uninterrupted footpath forges through more than 800 miles of breathtaking scenery. This majestic coast teems with wildlife, geological mysteries, and centuries of human history.

programme.title: Undiscovered Vistas Season 2
programme.desc: Explore an island surrounded by the mighty Atlantic ocean, subjected to pounding waves and driving rain. From the Cliffs of Moher to the Giants Causeway, this land has been shaped and reshaped by the power of water and violent geological forces.

programme.title: Undiscovered Vistas Season 2
programme.desc: Journey to the wild Pacific coast on the western shore of Vancouver Island in British Columbia. From the peaks of mountain glaciers to the canopies of Canadas only rainforest, nature and human spirit coexist in spectacular habitats.

programme.title: Rooted Season 1
programme.desc: Across rippled dunes, in the wind-swept grasslands of the southern Kalahari towers a magnificent Camelthorn. It has stood here for two centuries. This tree is never lonely, learn how it provides food, shelter and a hunting ground to many creatures.

programme.title: Rooted Season 1
programme.desc: Discover the story of the much loved Sausage Tree, whose nectar filled blooms and sausage shaped fruits entice animals of all kinds, from insects to elephants. See how the very animals who rely on this generous tree ensure its proliferation.

programme.title: Rooted Season 1
programme.desc: In a misty South African forest grows a six hundred year old Outeniqua Yellowwood. At forty meters tall, she towers above the canopy and is one of the few remaining of her kind. Follow her captivating story, unique as the ecosystem in her branches.

programme.title: Rooted Season 1
programme.desc: The Namaqua Rock Fig Tree stands rooted on the slope of a rocky hill in Namaqualand, South Africa. It is the ultimate survivor, able to withstand the unforgiving conditions in a landscape facing ever rising temperatures and less and less rainfall each year.

programme.title: Rooted Season 1
programme.desc: This is the incredible story of a tree that has been around for eight hundred years that can withstand the harshest conditions and that is more loved by insects, birds and animals than any otherthe enormous Baobab. Rooted on the savannah of Malilangwe Game Reserve in southern Zimbabwe.

programme.title: Boss Shark
programme.desc: Witness the ultimate battle for dominance as scientists try to pick out the alpha male in a pack of 100-plus great white sharks off the New Zealand coast. Marvel at the speed, hunting prowess, and fearlessness that determine the leader of the pack.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway Season 1
programme.desc: Embark on a dangerous tagging mission in South Australia that will show what sharks eat and why they gather in feeding hot spots. Then head north as a team chases tiger, bull, and hammerhead sharks and outfits one with a 360-degree dorsal camera.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway Season 1
programme.desc: Track a pregnant shark along the Great Barrier Reef and see if she leads a team of scientists to her hidden pupping ground. Then search for signs of mating along the southern coast that could reveal a very shy female megashark in search of a partner.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway Season 1
programme.desc: Stay up late as the northern team attaches an activity tag to a bull shark and finds out what this night owl does after sunset. Then dive 80 meters deep with the southern team, who are hoping to put a satellite tracker on a female great white.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway Season 1
programme.desc: Ponder shark community hierarchies as the northern team studies how young blacktips learn social and survival skills. Then rush to Rainbow Beach with the southern team, who are eager to witness the sand tiger sharks most elusive behaviour: mating.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway Season 1
programme.desc: Travel to the ends of Australias shark highways. Find out if Greenly Island in the south is a truck stop for migrating great whites, then search for proof of a genetic connection between northern bull sharks and their cooler-climate cousins.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway Season 1
programme.desc: Follow the southern team as they test new migration tech and tools that could reduce shark attacks in a popular snorkelling spot. Then catch and tag bull sharks with the northern team, who want to help local swimmers steer clear of birthing mothers.

programme.title: 听！台湾在唱歌 2Listen! Taiwan Sings 2
programme.desc: 第二季的节目由旺福乐团主唱姚小民首次担纲主持，背着吉他走访台湾各地，与歌手来宾一同探索在地文化与音乐故事他以音乐人的独特视角重新诠释经典歌曲，透过真诚而温暖的旅程，带领观众感受台湾的人文风情与土地魅力新世代的金奖歌手，将走唱更多老歌及在地故事Hosted by Wonfus frontman Yao Xiao Min, this season travels across Taiwan with award-winning guest artistes, reimagining classic songs and uncovering local stories through music. A heartfelt journey celebrating Taiwans people and heritage.

programme.title: 型男大主厨Stylish Man
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖每一期将有不同的主题：大明星來下廚由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；五分钟出好菜由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的

programme.title: 追分成功Define Your Own Success
programme.desc: 这是一部现代家庭伦理剧，看同住一屋簷下的单身房客，北漂追求梦想，在收获爱情友情的同时，也面临得到与失去他们向往完美爱情渴望幸福婚姻追求事业高升，不停向前追分，在这一路跌撞相互陪伴的欢笑与泪水中，定义属于自己的成功！This drama series follows a group of single tenants under the same roof who travelled north to pursue their dreams, love and friendship. They yearn for perfect love, long for a happy marriage, and a good career advancement. Stumbling along the way with tears and laughter, they each define success by their own standards.

programme.title: 白日提灯Love Beyond the Grave
programme.desc: 该剧讲述了天赋卓然的鬼王贺思慕，在休沐觅食时意外遇见了小将军段胥，两人互相试探，互通五感贺思慕终于了解了段胥黑暗的过往以及心中的志向，段胥也发现了贺思慕的坚守和孤独，寿命不过百年的凡人和四百岁仍是少女的恶鬼，以爱意抵抗时间洪流，携手守护美好人间The four-hundred-year-old strong female ghost master He Si Mu and the mysterious major general Duan Xu met because of the broken delusion sword. Since then, they agreed contractually to exchange their five senses, and continued to work together to maintain peace between the human and spiritual worlds.

programme.title: 爱情没有神话Lady Liberty
programme.desc: 该剧改编自亦舒同名小说，讲述了以林展翘何韩为代表的独身男女们，在事业与情感的交织浪潮中，彼此形成深厚羁绊，他们不断探寻自我，最终与爱人朋友一道绽放绚烂人生的故事Lady Liberty is adapted from Yi Shus famous novel of the same name. The drama follows Lin Zhanqiao, a financially independent woman, who is not against marriage but is unwilling to settle for less. She meets He Dezhang, and their relationship evolves as they navigate growth and choices in love and career. The drama also explores the lives of Lin Zhanqiaos female friends, their life choices, and their journey...

programme.title: Bukan Kahwin Paksa
programme.desc: Ariyana cuba memujuk Izz kembali, tetapi ditolak demi kebahagiaan Azz. Sementara itu, Izz dan Dara bakal dikahwinkan tanpa sedar mereka sebenarnya merupakan rakan karib di media sosial.

programme.title: Bukan Kahwin Paksa
programme.desc: Kereta pancit Dara mempertemukan dirinya dan Izz di jalanan, mencetuskan pertengkaran. programme.desc: Usop cuba dapatkan wok dengan mencari deris. Namun siapa diri deris sudah mulai terbongkar. Dia tidak endah permintaan usop mengenai pemergiaan maimun. Betapa kejamnya deris, tidak langsung membawa wok balik untuk melihat arwah maimun untuk kali terakhir. Wok disiksa teruk dan tekad cuba membunuh deris.

programme.title: WOK
programme.desc: Wok terus didera, diikat. Sesekali dilayan, selalu lebih kepada hamba abdi. Deris semakin lupa daratan. Usop masih belum dapat mencari wok. Deris mula mendapat selera baru. Cuba menlanggani wani, budak baru berjinak-jinak menjadi call girl. Paling sedih, wani adalah adik Alai.

programme.title: Bukan Kahwin Paksa

programme.title: Bukan Kahwin Paksa

programme.title: Bukan Kahwin Paksa

programme.desc: Dihantui gangguan misteri, sepasang suami isteri mula mencari punca kepada gangguan tersebut. Profesor Hamdan dan Ramlah serta anak mereka, Saiful dan Marina berpindah ke sebuah banglo lama di tepi laut. Mereka hidup aman dan damai bersama di banglo tersebut. Namun tragedi melanda apabila Marina lemas di laut dan meninggal dunia - dari situlah bermulanya kejadian aneh.

programme.title: Seru
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang sebuah produksi yang sedang membuat satu penggambaran filem seram bertajuk Jangan Bernafas. Semasa penggambaran berlangsung, secara tiba-tiba, pelbagai kejadian aneh dan peristiwa berlaku, diluar jangkaan mereka. Pada mulanya, mereka menganggap ia hanyalah rasukan biasa dan kru di sebalik pembikinan filem tersebut, ingin menjadikannya sebagai footage menarik untuk tujuan promosi filem tersebut. Namun, seorang demi seorang menjadi sasaran rasukan dan juga pembunuhan, menyebabkan keadaan menjadi tidak terkawal... tetapi kamera yang digunakan, masih terus merakamkan aksi yang terjadi.

programme.title: Sepi Itu Indah
programme.desc: Liz seorang gadis remaja yang tinggal di Terengganu bersama bapanya Pak Chad, bekas pejuang kemerdekaan berhaluan kiri. Dia bercita-cita untuk menjadi seorang penulis terkenal. Selepas kematian Pak Chad, Liz meninggalkan kampung halamannya dan pergi ke rumah Datuk Kamarul, rakan seperjuangan bapanya yang kini sudah berjaya dalam bidang politik dan perniagaan di Petaling Jaya. Datuk Kamarul mempunyai dua orang anak iaitu Zamri dan Zaiton. Liz kemudiannya menjadi anak angkat kepada Datuk Kamarul dan menyambung persekolahannya dalam aliran sastera. Kehadiran Liz dalam keluarga itu telah membuatkan hubungan Zamri dan kekasihnya Ita, menjadi renggang.

programme.title: Suratan Kasih
programme.desc: Sunny mengalami tekanan jiwa selepas melihat ibunya yang sedang berzina mati dibunuh ayahnya sendiri. Apabila meningkat dewasa, Sunny menjadi seorang pembunuh bersiri di sebalik kerjayanya sebagai komposer dan pemuzik. Mangsanya ialah golongan artis yang melakukan perbuatan zina. Dalam masa yang sama, Sunny mencintai seorang penyanyi baharu yang bernama Natasha.

Seroja, gadis yang menyewa tapak tanak bapa mereka untuk membuka warung turut terlibat apabila dia digunakan Pak Joko.

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils 2021
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng played by Yang Youning, the leader of the Beggars Sect Duan Yu played by Bai Shu, the prince of Dali and Xu Zhu played by Zhang Tianyang, a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by love.

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the caseolder adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organizations definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demandwhat are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the stories behind the flavors.

programme.title: Narcotics Heroes
programme.desc: Against the backdrop of neon lights in Hong Kong, there is a hidden dark side that nobody knows - the city is the hub of narcotics from all over the world. Rewind ten years and Narcotics Bureau has apprehended Man Wah, aka Drug Lord Moses Chan. However, undercover officer Ip Ho-tin Edwin Siu is sacrificed as he is injected with a colossal dose of dope, and he has since lost his feelings. Fast-forward ten years and Man Wah suffers from cancer and is given pardon and released from prison. He seemingly lives out the rest of his life by running some upstairs bookstore. Actually, he covertly asks his old love Cheung Lam Nancy Wu and a dumb guy called Tsui On-lok Matthew Ho to engage in online drug dealing. And he uses Cheung Lams status in the financial field for money laundering in the stock market. A missing police officer case sends shock waves across Hong Kong. Ho-tin is reassigned back to Narcotics Bureau to collaborate with his ex-girlfriend Ting Yeuk-ning Kelly Cheung. A war on drugs again breaks out

programme.title: Cantoxicating! Sr.4
programme.desc: The Cantonese word gaigui ?? is vivid and profound, with many Hong Kong slang terms originating from various parts of Guangdong Province. Gaigui Ambassador Mayanne Mak has expanded her exploration to China, inviting Tang Chi-kin, Thye Cho-yee, and Hui Man-hin to join the Gaigui Guided Tour to delve into inland cities like Guangzhou, uncovering interesting anecdotes and origins. Professional Cantonese and historical experts will also appear, tracing origins and citing classical texts to reveal the charm of local Cantonese. Furthermore, Tang Chi-kin, who enjoys playing pranks, will transform into a single, nerdy man on the show, showcasing his pursuit of various goddesses and helping viewers understand the meanings of many slang terms and idioms.

programme.title: Somethings Missing
programme.desc: With AI becoming increasingly powerful, what happens if crucial details in a scene are subtly erased by it? Will everyone be able to retrieve the missing parts from memory, or will they all be left in a state of brain fog? Ruco Chan, along withJenny Ian and Felix Lam, co-host the quiz game show Somethings Missing, inviting two teams of celebrity artists each episode to battle wits and compete for a prize. In the show, AI acts as a memory eraser, altering familiar dramas, classic music, landmark scenes, and more. Team members must use their memories to uncover the erased truth. After four rounds of intense brainpower, the team with the highest accumulated score will have the chance to win the Jackpot!

programme.title: A Date with Goddess Sr.2
programme.desc: The dating reality show A Date with Goddess is back with a bang, and the second seasons love battlefield is all upgraded! Golden Matchmaker Bob Lam is recruiting men from around the world to pair up goddesses Ho Pei-Chia, Kuo Pei-Wen, Chen Ruo-Si, Yu Ke-Cheng, and Yuen Ka-Man. The brave suitors face challenges like pressing the heart-fluttering light and a date at the Five Corners, each employing their own unique strategies to win over the goddesses. One-on-one intimate games ignite heart-pounding excitement, and a hidden goddess joins the fray, further intensifying the sparks More challenges await, and the brave suitors strive to reach the end and capture the goddesses hearts! In addition, the five goddesses from last season, along with celebrity guests, take turns becoming the Peanut Team, providing live coverage of the goddesses dates.

programme.title: Love On A Diet

programme.title: The Elites Talk
programme.desc: In the first episode, Chiu Kwok-hung is joined by two guestsPatrick Liu, Tax and Business Advisory Leader for Hong Kong at Deloitte China, and Jason Fong, Global Head of Family Offices at InvestHKto analyze how Hong Kong has attracted a large number of family offices. This success is driven by favorable conditions, including a diverse range of investment products, a simple tax regime, ease of investment, and the One Country, Two Systems framework. By the end of 2025, Hong Kong was home to 3,380 single-family officesan increase of over 25 compared to the end of 2023. Through their direct operating expenditures, these family offices contribute more than HK12.6 billion to Hong Kongs economy annually.

programme.title: Chill. Hike. Camping
programme.desc: With travel restricted due to the pandemic, many people have opted to connect with nature and discover the joys of local outings and camping. Four former Miss Hong Kong contestantsHo Wing-sau, Liu Wai-yee, Wu Mei-yee, and Chan Yeuk-szeset aside their formalities and escaped the hustle and bustle of city life, joining various outdoor experts on adventures. They explored mountains and seas, experiencing outdoor activities like picnics, mountain art photography, car parking, diving, kitesurfing, and even taking on challenges like mountain art tests, boating to collect trash on deserted beaches, and rappelling on a deserted island. programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, Todays news is tomorrows history. With so much news every day, its hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure troveif we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program News Treasure Hunt guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lees funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queens visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Pattens arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success.

programme.title: News At 18:30
programme.desc: Jade Channel reports important local, cross-strait, and international news every afternoon at 6:30.

programme.title: Sunday Report 2026 Yes, Boss.
programme.desc: Sunday Report focuses each week on popular newsmakers with feature reports, or takes a human-centered approach by visiting people from various social strata and industries to explore in depth political, social, and livelihood issues that concern the public.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: Scoop airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The Todays Breaking News segment keeps viewers up to date with the days hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Somethings Missing
programme.desc: With AI becoming increasingly powerful, what happens if crucial details in a scene are subtly erased by it? Will everyone be able to retrieve the missing parts from memory, or will they all be left in a state of brain fog? Ruco Chan, along withJenny Ian and Felix Lam, co-host the quiz game show Somethings Missing, inviting two teams of celebrity artists each episode to battle wits and compete for a prize. In the show, AI acts as a memory eraser, altering familiar dramas, classic music, landmark scenes, and more. Team members must use their memories to uncover the erased truth. After four rounds of intense brainpower, the team with the highest accumulated score will have the chance to win the Jackpot!

programme.title: A Date with Goddess Sr.2
programme.desc: The dating reality show A Date with Goddess is back with a bang, and the second seasons love battlefield is all upgraded! Golden Matchmaker Bob Lam is recruiting men from around the world to pair up goddesses Ho Pei-Chia, Kuo Pei-Wen, Chen Ruo-Si, Yu Ke-Cheng, and Yuen Ka-Man. The brave suitors face challenges like pressing the heart-fluttering light and a date at the Five Corners, each employing their own unique strategies to win over the goddesses. One-on-one intimate games ignite heart-pounding excitement, and a hidden goddess joins the fray, further intensifying the sparks More challenges await, and the brave suitors strive to reach the end and capture the goddesses hearts! In addition, the five goddesses from last season, along with celebrity guests, take turns becoming the Peanut Team, providing live coverage of the goddesses dates.

programme.title: Star Weekly
programme.desc: The talk show Star Weekly invites celebrities and industry leaders each episode, along with entertainment anchors such as Au Wing-Kuen, Hsu Wen-Hsuan, and Wang Chen-Chuan, to share their recent work plans and discuss special topics related to movies, television, and concerts, especially people and events that netizens and friends in the industry are concerned about and discussing! With so much surrounding information, the show features a special Fact Check segment, where guests personally respond to various rumors, allowing the parties involved to clarify the truth!

programme.title: J Music 2026
programme.desc: J Music is dedicated to creating a high-quality music platform, providing singers with opportunities to showcase their musical talents while allowing music fans to gain a deeper understanding of their musical stories. The program invites popular singers as guests, who personally select their favorite new and old works, perform them live, and share their favorite tracks. New faces in the music scene will also appear, showcasing their musical potential through interactive exchanges. Furthermore, each episode closely follows the latest developments on the Jade Solid Gold Chart, featuring music videos and interviews with various singers, songwriters, and producers, who discuss their work and the people and events within the music industry.

programme.title: Gourmet Express Weekly
programme.desc: Hong Kong is a melting pot of global cuisine! Food anchors and hosts like Carmaney Wong,Carmen Ngai,Gillian Ng stay up-to-date with the latest culinary trends, gathering information on top-rated restaurants from various platforms. The hosts personally sample the food and provide honest reviews they uncover hidden gems in different districts and invite long-time expatriates to visit their favorite hometown eateries renowned chefs and food critics also guide the way, offering expert recommendations. The program features a selection of popular restaurants featured in Food News Report, highlighting their signature dishes and delivering quick deals, ensuring viewers stay up-to-date with the most delicious and affordable dining information.

programme.title: Chun Hui
programme.desc: Chun Hui tells the inspiring true story of Ge Jianhao, an extraordinary mother who broke away from feudal traditions in rural Hunan to pursue revolutionary ideals. After unbinding her feet, she defied poverty and social prejudice to move her family across China and all the way to France for a work-study program. Studying alongside the younger generation, she championed womens education and supported the early Communist movement. Through her unwavering guidance, her childrenincluding key pioneers Cai Hesen, Cai Chang, and daughter-in-law Xiang Jingyubecame prominent leaders of the Communist Party of China.

programme.desc: Led by experienced journalists, this current-affairs documentary travels beyond borders to investigate major international stories and social issues. Each report combines on-location observation, interviews and human perspectives to explain how global events affect ordinary lives.

programme.title: Mr.Player
programme.desc: Jacky Wu leads a team of celebrity guests through energetic missions staged in different destinations. The players compete in creative games, physical challenges and surprise tasks that test teamwork, strategy and humour.

programme.title: Flavor of Life
programme.desc: After leaving a successful but unfulfilling career, Han-Shiao reopens her familys beloved bistro to rebuild her life and reconnect with her loved ones. As old romances return, hidden family secrets emerge, and three generations of women face love, sacrifice, forgiveness, and new beginnings.

programme.title: Detective Dee And Nine-storey Demon Building
programme.desc: A series of strange incidents happen at the Tangs demon building but Detective Dee finds no clue. Dee finds the master of the family suspicious when he speaks with him, and when the eldest daughter Miss Tang secretly informs Dee about Mr Tangs strange behavior and the fact that she is kept under surveillance, Dee vows to unveil the truth.

programme.title: Detective Chinatown 1900
programme.desc: In 1900s San Francisco, a white woman is murdered in Chinatown, and a Chinese man becomes the prime suspect. The crime sparks public outcry to shut down the district. Amid growing unrest, two Chinese detectives, Qin Fu and Ah Gui, race against time to uncover the true killer before prejudice and danger consume their community.

programme.title: The White Storm 2: Drug Lords
programme.desc: Drug lord Jizo joins forces with Mexican cartels, throwing Hong Kongs drug underworld into chaos. Determined to eradicate narcotics, billionaire Yu Shun Tin offers a HK100 million bounty on drug traffickers while concealing a dark bond with Jizo. As their shared past resurfaces, an explosive showdown becomes inevitable.

programme.title: The Invisible Guest
programme.desc: Young and beautiful entrepreneur Joanna is a prime suspect in a locked-room murder where her lover is found dead. She pays off a police officer to prove her innocence. During the investigation, they discover another murder case involving Joanna and her lover, and eventually reveals the truth.

programme.title: L Storm
programme.desc: ICAC Chief Officer Luk and Chief Inspector Lau both hit a dead end when investigating their respective bribery and money laundering cases. When Luk is accused of bribery after being framed by the money launderers, he risks everything he has to find crucial evidence against them to clear his name.

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A special agent from the Japanese National Security teams up with a skilled thief to find a pair of plates used to make counterfeit USD. However, a US Embassy representative appears and steals the plates, running away to Korea with them.

programme.title: Stand Up Story
programme.desc: Mancer knows his father Wah is intellectually challenged since young and has to take care of him after his mother left them. When Mancer discovers and finds solace in stand-up comedy, he learns that hardships provide the best comedic material - from his own school ridicule experience to pandemic woes, misery can fuel laughter!

programme.title: Tales from the Occult: Ultimate Malevolence
programme.desc: The final chapter of Tales From The Occult, the movie features three short stories about two high school friends, a magician undergoing hypnosis to find her missing friend, and a man finding his way out of a mysterious building. The stories reveal the most terrifying and ugly side of human nature, where life and death are just a thought away!

programme.title: Sky on Fire
programme.desc: The chief security officer at a top-secret medical facility finds himself caught in an explosive battle when a young thief steals a groundbreaking medicine. After discovering the true origins of the medicine however, the officer must decide who he can trust to protect the cure from falling into the wrong hands and prevent an all-out war.

programme.title: Busted Water Pipes
programme.desc: With crime almost non-existent in town, the police face the axe. To save their jobs, officer Yu Da Hai stages a fake robbery for his team to heroically foil. Unbeknownst to him, a gang of tomb raiders is tunnelling towards buried treasure beneath the station. When a water pipe bursts, chaos erupts and the line between cops and crooks blurs.

programme.title: Possession Street
programme.desc: When seven vengeful spirits turn the tenants of an abandoned mall into zombies, a video store owner, his daughter and a feng shui master must fight for survival. As the undead multiply and the evil spirits grow stronger, they race to stop the haunting before the entire mall descends into a living hell.

programme.title: Someone Like Me
programme.desc: Mui, who lives with cerebral palsy, longs for connection and meets volunteer Kin. As their wounded souls grow closer, she begins to rethink love and her self-worth beyond the limits of her body, discovering the courage to embrace life and intimacy on her own terms.

programme.title: Burning Stars
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Shanghai under the shadow of White Terror, agent Li Yi Min is tasked with escorting a key figure to safety. He reunites with former allies to break through deadly traps. Amid the turmoil, a group of idealistic youths join the cause, risking everything to uphold the mission and find courage in a time of chaos.

programme.title: Wild City
programme.desc: A cop-turned-bar-owner befriends a drunken woman at closing hours and finds himself pursued by her former lover and the thugs he employs. The chase turns deadly when the bar owners deadbeat brother and a suitcase full of cash enter the picture.

programme.title: The Last Dance
programme.desc: Amid the recession caused by the pandemic, debt-ridden wedding planner, Sheng, finds a lifeline as he transitions into a funeral planner. His unconventional approach leads to unexpected success, and his attitude toward his career and life is transformed after being inspired by the respected Master Wen.

programme.title: Article 20
programme.desc: Han Ming, a prosecutor, faces a whirlwind of complications in his work and family lives: his sons clash with another student in school and his wifes intervention, as well as the strained partnerships at work. Amidst it all, a critical case challenges his sense of righteousness, and he decides to gamble everything to seek fairness and justice.

programme.title: Detective Vs. Sleuths
programme.desc: Hong Kong is rocked by a series of cold-blooded murders whose victims are runaway suspects of unsolved cases. The group of killers calls themselves The Chosen Sleuths. Former top detective Lee vows to bring the brutal killers to justice and prove himself to be the real Chosen Sleuth instead of a lunatic.

programme.title: The Ex-files 4: Marriage Plan
programme.desc: Two brothers, Meng Yun and Yu Fei, are of marriageable age and are facing challenges in love. Yun dodges family pressure to marry after his breakup, while Fei and his girlfriend opt for a marriage cooling-off period to tackle marriage issues.

programme.title: Shes Got No Name
programme.desc: In 1945 Shanghai, a gruesome murder shocks Jiang Yuan Nong. Frail woman Zhan Zhou Shi, driven to despair by years of domestic abuse, kills and dismembers her husband, then remains at the scene to surrender. The case seems clear-cut, yet remains riddled with doubt. As the truth unravels, a shocking reversal rewrites everyones fate.

programme.title: Twilight of the Warriors: Walled In
programme.desc: Young Chan Lok Kwun accidentally stumbles into the Kowloon Walled City while fleeing, subsequently finding purpose amid chaos and gaining wisdom. Bonding with Shin, Twelfth Master and AV, they unite under Tornados leadership to defend against the villain, Mr Bigs assaults, and pledge to protect the safe haven of the Walled City together.

programme.title: Look Up
programme.desc: This film celebrates the 25th anniversary of Hong Kongs Handover in a series of four cultural stories about young Hong Kongers from different walks of life: a young man with autism pursuing his dream, a reconciliation between father and son, a Chinese opera star helping young pop singers, and a Nepali youth becoming a professional lion dancer.

programme.title: Ultimate Revenge
programme.desc: A series of jewellery heists rocks the city. As task force leader Cheng Zhi Bun hunts the culprits, he discovers the gang leaders are the long-wanted Yuen brothers. Old scores and new grievances collide as team member Cheung Ka Wo, driven by his brothers death, begins to unravel, and a brutal shootout uncovers a secret buried for years.

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: A young musician Chi Chiang is hired by the manager of a popular band when the groups drummerleader Charlie, quits to join a rival group. The new drummer becomes an immediate hit, causing Charlie to be very jealous. Furthermore, the young drummers mother is dead set against him having a music career.

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: Kao Chien Fei is a young swordsman who wields a special sword with a teardrop marked on its blade. He is charged with averting an impending crisis in the martial arts world, but the villain, Zhou Tung Lai, wishes to become the ruler in the martial arts world, and launches a scheme to pit the various heroes against one another.

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Wealthy heir Ping Chien Jen spurns the family business for a travel agency with his girlfriend Su Yung Lan. While they are hosting visitors from Hong Kong, a student falls for Chien Jen, sparking tension. Consumed by jealousy, Yung Lan storms off, and the student crashes her car after learning of his engagement. Misunderstandings are eventually cleared, and happiness follows.

programme.title: The Iron Buddha
programme.desc: After a notorious rapist Xiao kills his master and the entire clan, Han the last surviving disciple, decides to take revenge. He must find the legendary Hulong Blade to counter Xiaos Evil Poisonous Sword, but as Han has never seen Xiao before, he is deceived when Xiao poses as an ally to try and steal his Blade in the process.

programme.title: The Big Sting
programme.desc: Three buddies find a rare artifact known as the Double-Faced God but are poisoned by Lady Wu who steals the treasure from them. Before they die, they get their wives to promise to train their children to take back what is rightfully theirs. These kids grow up to exact a vengeance that turns out to be more hilarious than horrific in this comedy.

programme.title: Killers Five
programme.desc: The Dukes daughter has been kidnapped by the notorious Golden Dragon Hill bandits. A swordman named Yue Zhen Bei is assigned to save her, and expecting many dangers on the journey, Yue garners help from a group of good friends who are also kung fu masters.

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: In the Ming Dynasty, scholar Tian Yu Chuan defends a fishermans honour but accidentally kills the governors son, driving him into exile. Pursued to the rivers edge, he is rescued by the fishermans daughter. Amid danger, love blossoms between them, and Tian seals their bond with his family heirloom, the Butterfly Chalice.

programme.title: The Proud Youth
programme.desc: Ling Hu Chong, a Huashan clans disciple, is assigned to find the successor to the score The Proud One. Ling identifies Ying for the score but finds out that she is the daughter of the evil clans leader. At the same time, he is unwittingly dragged into an epic power struggle between clans, with complicated allegiances and perplexing moralities.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: The Reckless Cricket
programme.desc: Inspired by Drunken Master, this kung fu comedy features a bumbling martial artist creating a cricket-style fighting arts to fight and defeat the different martial artists who have beaten him before.

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxus enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power.

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s a-go-go era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: The Brave Archer
programme.desc: On his way back to the midlands, Guo Jing meets Huang Rong and they quickly fall in love. However, Ouyang Ke proposes to marry Huang Rong at the same time, so Huangs father sets up a duel for the two men to compete for her hand. Guo Jing finally beats Ouyang Ke to win Huang Rong back.

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: In this musical drama, Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl, falls in love with a handsome boatman Ta Lung. However, she cannot afford to marry him because of her fathers towering debt from gambling. To complicate the matter, a rival suitor promises to pay off all her fathers debts on one condition: that Hsiu Hsiu marries him...

programme.title: Super Inframan
programme.desc: Transformed from a young laboratory researcher, the thunderbolt-fisted Inframan must battle Princess Dragon Mom who wakes up from hibernation to conquer the earth with her army of mutant monsters.

programme.title: The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: Fang Ming marries the mysterious young lady Leng Qiu Ping, only to discover she is a spirit forced to drain mens life essence. With a Taoists help, he frees her from an evil force, but their love cannot cross life and death, and they part at dawn in a bittersweet farewell.

programme.title: The Heroic Ones
programme.desc: Set in the Tang Dynasty, the 13 adopted sons of Sha Tuo King are all renowned as royal warriors. David Chiang plays the 13th Prince, a powerful fighter whose prestigious status provokes jealously, leading to a gruesome family feud.

programme.title: The Anonymous Heroes
programme.desc: Carefree drifters Meng Gang and Tie Hu discover their purpose after meeting the revolutionary leader, Wan Tai. With the help of Meng Gangs girlfriend, they infiltrate a warlord camp to seize weapons for the revolutionary cause. Following a fierce battle, all three make the ultimate sacrifice, becoming the Anonymous Heroes of the revolution.

programme.title: Swordsman at Large
programme.desc: Hsiao Shi Yi Lang is the Swordsman at large who everyone wants to kill. A magnificient sword is even created for this purpose though the blade is soon coveted more than the swordsmans death by it! Bandits, beauties and blade masters battle for survival in this exciting story of deceit, betrayal, and death.

programme.title: The Protectors
programme.desc: Ling Hsiao and Kuan Wang Lung are two guard chiefs working for an old convoy master. Lung is secretly in love with Fang Yen, the masters granddaughter but Yen is attracted to Ling Hsiao instead. In order to win her back, Lung sets up a trap to steal the convoy and frames Ling Hsiao for it.

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured by her mother-in-law into putting up with Blackie and offer 1M for her baby...

programme.title: Trilogy Of Swordsmanship
programme.desc: A kung fu anthology film consisting of three stories: a man embarrasses himself while trying to prove his worth to the father of the woman he loves a courtesan in love with a general will need to deliver a notorious bandit in exchange for him not being executed and a group of bandits forms a plan to rescue a new friend from being executed.

programme.title: The Bells of Death
programme.desc: Wei Fu is an unremarkable woodcutter. However, when psychotic marauders killed his family and abducted his sister, he goes through vigorous martial arts training with an expert swordsman in order to exact revenge on the evildoers.

programme.title: The Supreme Swordsman
programme.desc: After beating several famous swordsmen, Chin Wu Hsin of the Mo Shan clan challenges Supreme Swordsman to a duel, hoping to win his title, and is beaten and humiliated. The winner taunts him to find a Supreme Sword made by Old Eagle, a famous sword-maker. When his offer to buy a sword from Old Eagle, is turned down, he challenges Old Eagle to a duel, and snatches his sword in a foul play. Old Eagles own son Shih Yen-peh vows to avenge for his father...

programme.title: A Friend From Inner Space
programme.desc: A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together.

programme.title: Valimai
programme.desc: A citys crime rate rises due to a notorious motorcycle club. When chaos ensues, police officer Arjun takes charge to restore law and order.

programme.title: Enai Noki Paayum Thota
programme.desc: Lovers Raghu and Lekha are torn apart by Lekhas guardian, Kuberan, who forces her to act in films. Years later, Raghu receives a call from her informing him about his estranged brother.

programme.title: Irumbu Thirai
programme.desc: A military officer borrows money for his sisters marriage using fake papers. When the money goes missing from his account, he embarks on an investigation that uncovers a hacker.

programme.title: Nayakan
programme.desc: A regular person fights unfair police, becoming a criminal boss. People like and respect him, but his power comes at a high price. It changes him and those around him.

programme.title: Ace
programme.desc: Kannan moves to a foreign country seeking life, but gets dragged into shark circle. A heist turns hope into a curse, forcing him to outsmart fate.

programme.title: Thondan
programme.desc: Narayanan, a politicians son, assaults Vishnu when his brother dies in his ambulance. Later, he makes Vishnus life miserable by bribing the local police officers and government officials.

programme.title: Sisters
programme.desc: Set in an abandoned house, the film follows a team of professional ghost hunters trying to conduct a paranormal investigation to unveil the mystery of two sisters.

programme.title: Kolamaavu Kokila
programme.desc: A young girl in Tamil Nadu turns to the local drug gang to save her dying mother, risking danger, loyalty, and her own future dramatically today.

programme.title: Free Ticket
programme.desc: The host presents a curated compilation of hit songs and memorable snippets from the most popular and trending Tamil movies, celebrating the best of Tamil cinema.
After mobiles start mysteriously flying out of the hands of people in Chennai, Dr Vaseegaran summons his trusted robot Chitti to ward off the bird-shaped supernatural powers of Pakshirajan.

programme.title: Thunder
programme.desc: A CBI officer gains consciousness after being in coma and finds everyone referring to him as Godse. He discovers that it is a trap set up by a CM.

programme.title: Brother
programme.desc: A young man struggles to find his place after moving in with his sister and her in-laws.

programme.title: Mersal
programme.desc: Maaran, is falsely arrested for the murder of his colleague, Dr Arjun Zachariah. He soon discovers that the real culprit is a lookalike who aims to expose corruption in the medical industry.

programme.title: Kadaisi Nodigal
programme.desc: When a serial killer goes on a murder spree, Samuel, a forensic expert, uses his skills to find evidence and uncover the killers identity.

programme.title: Sirai
programme.desc: Police officer Kathiravan must escort a prisoner from Vellore to Sivagangai court. Along the long road, unexpected encounters force both men to question everything they know.

Radio tracking collars are used for both initiatives to help conservationists better understand the elephants needs - and to see if theyre returning to their natural corridors.

programme.desc: Step into the Bay of Fundys surging waters. Learn how this east coast ecosystem sustains an abundance of creatures, including hundreds of thousands of seabirds, the worlds fastest predator, and a complex web of invertebrates.

programme.title: Undiscovered Vistas
programme.desc: Explore an island surrounded by the mighty Atlantic ocean, subjected to pounding waves and driving rain. From the Cliffs of Moher to the Giants Causeway, this land has been shaped and reshaped by the power of water and violent geological forces.

programme.title: Undiscovered Vistas

programme.title: Rooted

programme.title: Rooted
programme.desc: Discover the story of the much loved Sausage Tree, whose nectar filled blooms and sausage shaped fruits entice animals of all kinds, from insects to elephants. See how the very animals who rely on this generous tree ensure its proliferation.

programme.desc: In a misty South African forest grows a six hundred year old Outeniqua Yellowwood. At forty meters tall, she towers above the canopy and is one of the few remaining of her kind. Follow her captivating story, unique as the ecosystem in her branches.

programme.title: Rooted

programme.desc: Follow the southern team as they test new migration tech and tools that could reduce shark attacks in a popular snorkelling spot. Then catch and tag bull sharks with the northern team, who want to help local swimmers steer clear of birthing mothers.

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas
programme.desc: Welcome to India - a land of exotic animals and exotic warfare. Monkeys stage dusty dust-ups, blackbucks wage open war on the open plains, and peacock dandies swing switchblades: these are colorful battles worthy of a vibrant land.

programme.title: Kenya Wildlife Diaries
programme.desc: Elephant hunting has been banned in Kenya for 40 years. Organized gangs of armed poachers are still targeting elephants, illegally hunting them and selling their ivory tusks on the black market. Environmentalists and conservationists are sounding the alarm.

programme.title: Kingdom Of The Tide
programme.desc: Low tide exposes a band of shore called the intertidal zone. Its a place of stunning extremes, attacked by hurricane force waves and exposed to baking heat. Creatures here have evolved in countless bizarre ways. Scientists explore this alien realm.

programme.title: Wild Rockies
programme.desc: Where the mountains cross international borders, herds of elk and moose live side by side with predators like bears and wolves. The predatorprey relationship is a delicate balance, and the perfect place to see it in action is the Kootenay area of the Rocky Mountains.

programme.title: Wild Rockies
programme.desc: The air is thin and cold, trees cant even live here -- its not exactly a welcoming place to live. But animals like mountain goats and bighorn sheep and even black bears manage to skitter around these peaks with ease. Well take a look at how these creatures manage to defy gravity, among some of the highest peaks on the continent.

programme.title: Wild Rockies
programme.desc: Some of mightiest rivers in North America originate on the glacial heights of the Rocky Mountains. The lakes, rivers and marshes of the Rockies are like arteries pulsing through the landscape, feeding the creatures that call the mountains home. Fed by glaciers and motivated by gravity, these waterways are split by the massive Rockies, which divert flow into the Atlantic, Pacific, and Arctic Oceans. From the uninhabitable icy pecks, water melts off glaciers, runs down thunderous waterfalls, filters through wetlands, sculpts the terrain, and finally flows out to the ocean, sustaining life and transforming environments along the way.

programme.title: Wild Rockies
programme.desc: Survival in the forest means maintaining a delicate balance between growth and destruction and death and rebirth - a forest should be in a constant state of regeneration. When trees get too tall they block all the sunlight from hitting the ground, which means grasses and smaller shrubs cant grow, diminishing habitat for animals like elk, moose, caribou, and wolves.

programme.title: Wild Rockies
programme.desc: For a great many species, the structures of group living are the most important for survival. Although social living is integral to many of the animals that call the Rocky Mountains home, no two species organize their society in the same way. Even among closely related species there can be drastic differences in social structure communication, hierarchy, mating, and diet are all inextricably informed by specific environmental and genetic adaptations for group survival.

programme.title: Tales From Zambia
programme.desc: Zambias Luangwa Valley is home to Africas biggest and most fearsome giants, but what really makes it special are its birds. There are over 400 different species here each perfectly adapted to exploit every opportunity on offer.

programme.title: Tales From Zambia
programme.desc: Africa is a continent filled with unique and extraordinary creatures whose lives are shaped by millions of years of evolution. Africa is also the birthplace of humankind. We traveled alongside the continents animals on our own journey of evolution, yet intelligence took us on a very different path. Our curiosity led to questions about the world around us which were answered through stories, myths and legends.

programme.title: Tales From Zambia
programme.desc: Chilema is an Elephant with half a trunk losing the tip to a poachers snare. It was intended to catch antelope for bushmeat. But the snares indiscriminate nature means other animals often fall foul of them, with devastating results. Chilema is now having to adapt to life without an elephants most important appendage. She must learn how to eat, drink and also take a mud bath to ensure her survival. With the added challenge of the harsh dry season, Chilema is fighting against the odds to survive.

programme.title: Tales From Zambia
programme.desc: Trees are Africas oldest residents, and each has its own strategy for surviving the dry season. The sausage tree and the fig tree ride-out seasonal extremes, to provide food and shelter for struggling animals in the lean times. In return animals help these trees to reproduce by pollinating their flowers and dispersing their seed. African trees promote life, and form the backbone of one of Earths most precious ecosystems.

programme.title: The Oceans Greatest Feast
programme.desc: Get a front-row seat to the planets biggest biomass migration, the annual 1,000-mile sardine run along South Africas east coast. See billions of these tiny fish run a gauntlet of hungry predators, including stealthy seals and dive-bombing gannets.

programme.title: Boss Shark: Chasing Giants
programme.desc: Witness a shark competition unlike any other, where great whites go head-to-head in jaw-dropping tests of strength. Risk it all with shark specialist Dr. Riley Elliott as he tries to answer an age-old question: Which sex reigns supreme?

Fatso and Stretch just cannot stand Stinkys horrible smell for one single minute longer and they hatch a plan. They decide to wait for Stinky to fall asleep and then vacuum up the dreaded stink right out of Stinky. It works! the bad smell goes into the hoover bag but as the uncles start arguing, the bag bursts open and the bad smell escapes! The smell collides with Casper while hes going through the Dimension Tube to get back to Scare School and now its CASPER whos the stinky one. When Casper starts to stink out the school, everyones complaining.. Casper must do everything possible to get rid of the STINK! The Manor has Disappeared - Caspers uncles are out of town and have left the little ghost to take care of the Manor - Casper invites his best friend Jimmy over for a tour of the haunted manor - Casper even shows Jimmy the clock that controls the Dimension Tube connecting the manor to Scare School. Jimmy cant resist fiddling with EVERYTHING! - and as Jimmy pulls the wrong chain three times in a row he and the manor are sucked into the tube and shrunken down to the size of a hand! Casper has a massive problem on his hands as the little tiny house with the little tiny munchkin inside it causes a huge stir at Scare School and its all Caspers fault! Hes got only hours before his Uncles return to rescue his friend from perpetual munchkin-sizedness AND return his Uncles manor as they left it!

programme.title: Caspers Scare School

This perfume is supposed to turn the one who wears it into the loveliest person in the worldbut actually it just makes OTHERS think youre great, whilst not actually changing the person its been sprayed on! Thatch becomes more unbearable than ever as the kids at Scare School start to treat him like the biggest hero ever, totally putting him on a pedestal of sickening adoration.. Luckily, Caspers nose is blocked by a cold so he is the only student immune to the perfumes spell! He is also the only one who can fix his mistake! The Monster Catcher - Casper has been given a mysterious compass which belonged to his ancestor Jasper the Jester. The compass leads him to a secret room in Scare School. He takes his friends to this room and the three little monsters soon realize they are actually trapped in a terrible labyrinth!
